name: Achilló
subtitle: Jon's Achilles rehab log
description: Private AltStore source for the Achilló rehab app. Builds are published by the app's build script.

apps.name: Achilló
apps.subtitle: Guided Achilles rehab, by ear
apps.localizedDescription: Daily post-op Achilles program: BFR, Chris's barefoot and boot-on routines, hourly quick ones, hinge ladder, imagery. Audio cues keep going with the screen locked; reminders come from the app.

versions.localizedDescription: Session ring now has notches: outer ring = sets, inner ring = reps. Big number is the rep you're on for quick reps, seconds for holds and rests. Cuff time moved into the badge and turns red at 8 minutes.
Skipping now cuts off whatever is being said. Spoken lines stop where the next exercise (or your skip) lands.

Voice is now recorded into the session's audio file, so instructions can't drop out or talk over cues. The next likely session is prepared ahead on the Today screen, so Start plays right away. Skips land on the next exercise's spoken intro.
